text:
aria: quick alert  eu1 saw a sudden uptick in 5xx and p95 after today's model push (model-redwood-3.2.1 + tokenizer tweak). Can we do a region pin or rollback?

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Alert: eu1 /generate 5xx=13% (5m). Canary fraction: 9%. Active: model-redwood-3.2.1. Recommended: region pin to previous model or rollback image. Runbook: https://go/redwood/runbooks/fast-rollback
miguel: Logs show `GPU_ALLOC_FAILED` and `tokenizer: unk-length change`. Latency tails correlate with KV cache misses.

ops-lead: Policy: >10% 5xx over 5m => mitigate. I approve an expedited regional pin to v3.1.9. Notify support.

aria: executing:
```
/deploy pin model-redwood-3.1.9 --region eu1 --skip-canary --reason "5xx spike post 3.2.1 tokenizer change" --ticket INC-3472
```

deploy-bot: Pin command accepted from aria. Preflight OK. Rolling to 100% in eu1 with short ramp.
support: Notified CS and created support note about potential tokenization diffs for impacted customers.
miguel: running quick smoke (20 queries) now.
miguel: smoke: generation sanity OK, latency p95 back to baseline, no 5xx in checks :white_check_mark:.

deploy-bot: Pin complete. model-redwood-3.1.9 active in eu1. 5xx rolling avg now 0.6% over 3m.

releasebot: Drafting release/changelog: "Region pin: eu1 -> v3.1.9 to mitigate increased 5xx after v3.2.1 tokenizer change. Investigation ongoing; postmortem TBD." Draft PR: https://go/redwood/prs/5188

ops-lead: Keep region pinned for 2 hours and gather GPU heap dumps + full traces. File incident and assign owners.

aria: Filed INC-3472 and assigned follow-ups (telemetry, canary gating, tokenizer regression test). I'll own the postmortem.

support: Will prepare CS FAQ and escalation steps.

aria: thanks all, closing fast-path unless metrics regress.
